interpreted_intent: A quiet, poetic night-outing photograph of an adult bookish young woman using a telescope and camera on a Milky Way hill, while preserving the attached portrait's recognizable appearance.
subject: An unmistakably adult 23-year-old East Asian woman whose facial appearance follows the attached portrait.
setting: A quiet grassy hill beneath a sweeping Milky Way at night.
event: She adjusts a portable astronomical telescope while a mirrorless camera photographs the sky during a literary-minded outing.
visual_priorities: Preserve the attached portrait's recognizable face, chin-length dark bob, wispy bangs, and round black wire-frame glasses.
Make the Milky Way, grassy hill, telescope, camera, and literary picnic details read together as one believable night outing.
Balance a richly detailed night sky with a clearly legible adult subject and natural photographic light.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic nighttime lifestyle photograph of an unmistakably adult 23-year-old East Asian woman on a quiet grassy hill beneath a sweeping Milky Way. Her facial appearance follows the attached portrait: a neat chin-length dark-brown bob with wispy bangs, round black wire-frame glasses, large dark-brown eyes, and softly natural features. She is enjoying a literary-minded stargazing outing, wearing a cream blouse, navy cardigan, and long charcoal skirt, with an open poetry book and canvas satchel resting on a picnic blanket. Beside her, she adjusts the focus of a portable astronomical telescope while a mirrorless camera records the sky from a second tripod. A light breeze turns one page as she glances upward with quiet wonder. Make the star field richly detailed yet believable, and keep her face clearly recognizable in gentle warm lantern light balanced against cool blue moonlight. Use a medium-wide environmental portrait that clearly connects the woman, telescope, camera, book, rolling hill, and luminous galactic band in one coherent frame.
